evals.prompt: Evaluate two RAG prompt variants for customer ticket routing against the pinned eval-set-v2 snapshot without editing production code.
evals.expected_output: Runs an implement/evaluate comparison on identical frozen eval-set-v2 with 5 reproducibility anchors, compares against cheapest baseline, reports accuracy + P95 latency + cost ledger, and makes zero production code edits.

rubric.criterion: Pins eval-set-v2 snapshot and compares both candidates against baseline on identical split
Records 5 reproducibility anchors and latency/cost ledger
Makes zero production source edits during evaluate task

evals.prompt: Implement a production LLM extraction step for invoice parsing with timeout fallback and tenant isolation.

rubric.criterion: Enforces hard runtime bounds and 3-tier fallback chain
Enforces tenant/ACL isolation outside prompt text
Separates mocked contract tests from real eval-set quality evidence
